blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Supreme Court has struck down as unconstitutional provisions of the Magna Carta of Filipino Seafarers requiring workers to post a bond pending resolution of labor cases, as well as restricting legal remedies they may avail of, as they violate due process. The high tribunal, in an en banc session on Nov. 11, partially granted five consolidated petitions filed by various seafarers’ groups. The decision has yet to be made public. Among the petitioners were labor leader Sonny Matula and maritime and labor organizations Philippine Association of Maritime Institutions, Inc., Concerned Seafarers of the Philippines, and Association of […]...
